claims: The original ELF has separate NOBITS sections in main memory and scratchpad; PS2Recomp's report computes a single min/max BSS span from 0x290600 to 0x700035d0, so this report span includes unmapped address gaps.
The generated function-registration excerpt uses the bootstrap entry address/name, and the viewed code does not demonstrate that the min/max BSS span is used to zero memory at runtime.
